requirements.text: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.
requirements.quote: The requirements pertinent to each retro-reflecting device and to the category/ies of vehicle on which the retro-reflecting device is intended to be installed shall be applied, where its verification at the moment of retro-reflecting device type approval is feasible.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that the retro-reflective devices function satisfactorily and continue to do so in normal use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices shall be so constructed that they function satisfactorily and will continue to do so in normal use.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.
requirements.quote: In addition, they must not have any defect in design or manufacture that is detrimental to their efficient operation or to their maintenance in good condition.

requirements.text: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.
requirements.quote: The components of retro-reflective devices or parts thereof shall not be capable of being easily dismantled.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall be easy to clean.

requirements.text: The outer surface of retro-reflective devices shall not be rough.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: Any protuberances the outer surface of retro-reflective devices may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.
requirements.quote: The surface shall therefore not be rough and any protuberances they may exhibit shall not prevent easy cleaning.

requirements.text: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.
requirements.quote: There shall be no access to the inner surface of the retro-reflectors when in normal use.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflectors, where the retro-reflectors consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, the retro-reflectors shall be so designed that the combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflectors may consist of a combined retro-reflecting optical unit and filter, which must be so designed that they cannot be separated under normal conditions of use.

requirements.text: In case of retro-reflectors, the retro-reflecting optical units and filters shall not be coloured by means of paint or varnish.
requirements.quote: The colouring of retro-reflecting optical units and filters by means of paint or varnish is not permitted.

requirements.text: For the test procedure for night time colours, the specifications shall apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices.
requirements.quote: These specifications shall apply only to white, red or amber retro-reflective devices

requirements.text: When testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the retro-reflective device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1.
requirements.quote: For testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the device shall be illuminated by CIE Standard Illuminant A, with an angle of divergence of 1/3° and an illumination angle of β1= β2= 0° or, if this produces a colourless surface reflection, an angle as specified in Annex 4, Part 1, paragraph 1.1. shall be used.

requirements.text: When testing the colour of the retro-reflective device, the trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity of the retro-reflective device shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous intensity shall be within the limits for the night-time colour of the light retro-reflected from that device, as defined in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5.
requirements.quote: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet: (a) The dimensions and shape requirements set forth in Annex 5;

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: (b) The photometric and colorimetric requirements as specified in paragraphs 5.1.4. to 5.1.5.; and

requirements.text: Every retro-reflector of the Classes IA and IB, when tested according to paragraph 5.1.7., shall meet the physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.
requirements.quote: (c) The physical and mechanical requirements set forth in paragraph 5.1.7., depending on the nature of the materials and construction of the retro-reflective devices.

requirements.text: The applicant shall submit ten samples of the retro-reflector for approval, which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.
requirements.quote: The applicant shall submit ten samples for approval which shall be tested in the chronological order as indicated in paragraph 5.1.7.

requirements.text: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples of the retro-reflector shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: After verification of the general specifications (paragraph 4.) and the specifications of shape and dimensions (Annex 5), the ten samples shall be subjected to the heat resistance test described in Part 1 of Annex 6 and at least one hour after this test examined as to their colorimetric characteristics in paragraph 5.1.5. and RI in paragraph 5.1.4., for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° or if necessary, in the position defined in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: After the heat resistance test and examination, the two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: The two retro-reflectors giving the minimum and maximum values shall then be fully tested as shown in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: The two retro-reflector samples giving the minimum and maximum values shall be kept by the laboratories for any further checks which may be found necessary.
requirements.quote: These two samples shall be kept by the laboratories for any further checks which may be found necessary.

requirements.text: Four samples out of the remaining eight samples of the retro-reflector shall be selected at random and divided into two groups of two in each group.
requirements.quote: Four samples out of the remaining eight samples shall be selected at random and divided into two groups of two in each group.

requirements.text: The other eight samples of the retro-reflector shall be divided into four groups of two.
requirements.quote: The other eight samples shall be divided into four groups of two:

requirements.text: The two samples of the first group shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).
requirements.quote: First group: The two samples shall be subjected successively to the water penetration test (Part 2 of Annex 6) and then, if this test is satisfactory, to the tests for resistance to fuels and lubricants (Parts 1 and 2 of Annex 7).

requirements.text: The two samples of the second group shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.
requirements.quote: Second group: The two samples shall, if necessary, be subjected to the corrosion test in Part 4 of Annex 6, and then to the abrasive-strength test of the rear face of the retro-reflective device in Part 5 of Annex 6.

requirements.text: The two samples of the third group shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.
requirements.quote: Third group: The two samples shall be subjected to the test for stability in time of the optical properties of retro-reflective device in Part 3 of Annex 4.

requirements.text: The two samples of the fourth group shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).
requirements.quote: Fourth group: The two samples shall be subjected to the resistance to weathering test (Part 6 of Annex 6).

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.
requirements.quote: A colour which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.5.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the retro-reflectors in each group shall have a RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.
requirements.quote: A RI which satisfies the conditions laid down in paragraph 5.1.4.

requirements.text: After undergoing the tests referred to in the paragraph 5.1.3.1., the verification of the RI of the retro-reflectors in each group shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.
requirements.quote: The verification shall be performed only for an angle of divergence of 20' and an illumination angle of β1 = β2 = 0° or, if necessary, in all positions specified in Part 1 of Annex 4, paragraphs 1.1. and 1.2.

requirements.text: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.
requirements.quote: When applying for approval, the applicant shall specify one or more or a range of axis of reference, corresponding to the illumination angle β1 = β2 = 0° in the table of coefficients of luminous intensity RI.

requirements.text: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements of the retro-reflector shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.
requirements.quote: In the case where more than one or a range of different axis of reference are specified by the manufacturer, the photometric measurements shall be repeated making reference each time to a different axis of reference or to the extreme axis of reference of the range specified by the manufacturer.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered.
requirements.quote: For photometric measurements, only the illuminating surface defined by the planes contiguous to the outermost parts of the optical system of the retro-reflective device as indicated by the manufacturer and contained within a circle of 200 mm diameter for Class IA or IB shall be considered, and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.

requirements.text: For photometric measurements, the illuminating surface of the retro-reflective device itself shall be limited to 100 cm2, though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.
requirements.quote: and the illuminating surface itself shall be limited to 100 cm2 though the surfaces of the retro-reflecting optical units need not necessarily attain this area.

requirements.text: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area of the retro-reflective device to be used for photometric measurements.
requirements.quote: The manufacturer shall specify the perimeter of the area to be used.

requirements.text: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors of Class IA and Class IB shall be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.
requirements.quote: When measured as described in paragraph 3 of Part 1 of Annex 4, the RI values for red retro-reflectors must be equal to or greater than those in Table 3, expressed in millicandelas per lux, for the angles of divergence and illumination shown.

requirements.text: The retro-reflector of Class IA and Class IB shall not have RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).
requirements.quote: RI values lower than those shown in the last two columns of Table 3 are not permissible within the solid angle having the centre of reference as its apex and bounded by the planes intersecting along the following lines: (β1 = ±10°, β2 = 0°) (β1 = ±5°, β2 = ±20°).

requirements.text: In the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values shall be verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.
requirements.quote: However, in the case where a retro-reflector of Class IA or Class IB, is intended to be installed with its H plane at a mounting height less than 750 mm above the ground, the RI values are verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards.

requirements.text: The testing of the colour of the reflected light of the retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.
requirements.quote: The testing of the colour for retro-reflector (night-time colour) shall be carried out according to the method described in paragraph 4.2.1.

requirements.text: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux of the retro-reflector shall be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.
requirements.quote: The trichromatic coordinates of the reflected luminous flux must be within the limits for the night-time colours red, amber or white as specified in UN Regulation No. 48.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the retro-reflective device which is not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis of reference to the position of minimum RI, which shall conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices which are not marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes of reference to the position of minimum RI, which must conform to the value specified in paragraph 5. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device which is not marked "TOP" shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε.
requirements.quote: When the RI is measured for the other angles of illumination and divergence, the retro-reflective device shall be placed in the position corresponding to this value of ε.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the retro-reflective device marked "TOP" shall be rotated about its axis ±5°.
requirements.quote: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', retro-reflective devices marked "TOP" shall be rotated about their axes ±5°.

requirements.text: With an illumination angle β of β1 = β2 = 0°, or the angle specified in paragraph 4. of this Regulation, and an angle of divergence of 20', the RI of the retro-reflective device marked "TOP" shall not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.
requirements.quote: The RI must not fall below the prescribed value in any position assumed by the device during this rotation.

requirements.text: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements of the retro-reflective device for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.
requirements.quote: If for the direction β1 = β2 = 0°, and for ε = 0° the RI exceeds the specified value by 50 per cent or more, all measurements for all angles of illumination and divergence shall be made for ε = 0°.

requirements.text: The shape of the illuminating surfaces of the retro-reflective device of Class IA or IB shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.
requirements.quote: The shape of the illuminating surfaces shall not be easily confused with the triangular shape, as prescribed for retro-reflectors mentioned in paragraph 2.1., from an observation distance of 10 metres.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, the retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.

requirements.text: In the case of moulded plastics reflectors of retro-reflecting devices as Classes IA, IB, IIIA, IIIB, IVA, SMV and advance warning triangle of type 1, after being kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C, the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 °C.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device shall be kept for 48 consecutive hours in a dry atmosphere at a temperature of 65 °C ± 2 °C after which the sample shall be allowed to cool for 1 hour at 23 °C ± 2 ºC.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, the retro-reflective device shall show no visible cracking.
requirements.quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.

requirements.text: After the resistance to heat test, the retro-reflective device and, in particular, its optical component shall show no visible appreciable distortion.
requirements.quote: After this test, no cracking or appreciable distortion of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of its optical component must be visible.

requirements.text: For the resistance to water penetration test, the retro-reflective device, whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices whether part of a lamp or not, or a sample unit of retro-reflective marking, shall be stripped of all removable parts and immersed for 10 minutes in water at a temperature of 50 °C ± 5 °C, the highest point of the upper part of the illuminating surface being 20 mm below the surface of the water.

requirements.text: For the resistance to water penetration test, the immersion test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.
requirements.quote: This test shall be repeated after turning the retro-reflective device through 180°, so that the illuminating surface is at the bottom and the rear face is covered by about 20 mm of water.

requirements.text: For the resistance to water penetration test, the sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.quote: These sample units shall then be immediately immersed in the same conditions in water at a temperature of 25 °C ± 5 °C.

requirements.text: After the water penetration test, no water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.
requirements.quote: No water shall penetrate to the reflecting surface of the retro-reflecting optical unit.

requirements.text: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the retro-reflective device shall not be considered to have passed the test.
requirements.quote: If visual inspection clearly reveals the presence of water, the device shall not be considered to have passed the test.

requirements.text: If visual inspection does not reveal the presence of water or in case of doubt, in the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.
requirements.quote: In the case of retro-reflectors, the RI shall be measured by the method described in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation, the retro-reflective device being first lightly shaken to remove excess water from the outside.

requirements.text: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the moisture and dust tests shall be applied for the resistance to water penetration of retro-reflective devices of the Classes IB and IIIB.
requirements.quote: As an alternative, at the request of the manufacturer, the following tests (moisture and dust test) shall be applied.

requirements.text: In the water spray test procedure, a sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded, shall be subjected to a water spray as follows.
requirements.quote: Water spray test procedure A sample device mounted on a test fixture, with initial RI measured and recorded shall be subjected to a water spray as follows:

requirements.text: In the water spray test procedure, if the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.
requirements.quote: If the retro-reflector is reciprocally incorporated or grouped with signalling or lighting functions, these functions shall be operated at design voltage according to a cycle of 5 min ON (in flashing mode, where appropriate), 55 min OFF.

requirements.text: In the water spray test procedure, the water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).
requirements.quote: Test duration The water spray test shall last 12 hours (12 cycles of 5/55 min).

requirements.text: In the water spray test procedure, upon completion of the drain period, the interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.
requirements.quote: Upon completion of the drain period. The interior of the device shall be observed for moisture accumulation.

requirements.text: In the water spray test procedure, upon completion of the drain period, no standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed in the device, or be able to be formed by tapping or tilting the device.
requirements.quote: No standing pool of water shall be allowed to be formed, or which can be formed by tapping or tilting the device.

requirements.text: In the water spray test procedure, upon completion of the drain period, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.quote: The RI shall be measured according to the method specified in Part 1 of Annex 4 after having dried the exterior of the device with a dry cotton cloth.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth.
requirements.quote: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, after the exterior of the device has been cleaned and dried, the RI shall be measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: Upon completion of the dust exposure test, the exterior of the device shall be cleaned and dried with a dry cotton cloth and the RI measured according to the method specified in paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective devices shall be so designed that the retro-reflective devices retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which the retro-reflective devices are normally exposed.
requirements.quote: Retro-reflective devices must be so designed that they retain the prescribed photometric and colorimetric characteristics despite the humidity and corrosive influences to which they are normally exposed.

requirements.text: The resistance of the front surface of the retro-reflective device to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.
requirements.quote: The resistance of the front surface to tarnishing and of the protection of the rear face to deterioration shall be checked, particularly when an essential metal component seems liable to be attacked.

requirements.text: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.
requirements.quote: The retro-reflective device, or the lamp if the device is combined with a light, shall be stripped of all removable parts and subjected to the action of a saline mist for a period of 50 hours, comprising two periods of exposure of 24 hours each, separated by an interval of two hours during which the sample is allowed to dry.

requirements.text: Immediately after completion of the corrosion test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.
requirements.quote: Immediately after completion of the test, the sample shall not show signs of excessive corrosion liable to impair the efficiency of the device.

requirements.text: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:
requirements.quote: A test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol shall be applied for either:

requirements.text: When the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol is applied to a retro-reflective device, the outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.
requirements.quote: (a) The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, of the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in the test mixture.

requirements.text: When the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol is applied to a retro-reflective device, after about five minutes, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be inspected visually.
requirements.quote: (b) After about five minutes, the surface shall be inspected visually.

requirements.text: When the test mixture of 70 vol. per cent of n-heptane and 30 vol. per cent of toluol is applied to a retro-reflective device and the surface is inspected visually after about five minutes, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.
requirements.quote: It must not show any apparent surface changes, except that slight surface cracks will not be objected to.

requirements.text: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.
requirements.quote: The outer surface of the retro-reflective device and, in particular, the illuminating surface, shall be lightly wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil.

requirements.text: After the outer surface of the retro-reflective device has been wiped with a cotton cloth soaked in a detergent lubricating oil, after about 5 minutes, the surface of the retro-reflective device shall be cleaned.
requirements.quote: After about 5 minutes, the surface shall be cleaned.

requirements.text: After the surface of the retro-reflective device has been cleaned, the RI of the retro-reflective device shall be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The RI shall then be measured according to paragraph 5.1.3.2.2. of this Regulation.

requirements.text: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall either specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA.
requirements.quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall: (a) Specify the approval number according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128, granted to this ESA;

requirements.text: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source, the applicant shall, as an alternative to specifying the approval number, provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.
requirements.quote: (b) Provide a test report by a Technical Service designated by the Type Approval Authority, stating that this ESA is not mechanically interchangeable with any light source according to Regulation No. 37, Regulation No. 99 or Regulation No. 128.

requirements.text: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.
requirements.quote: If the representative ESA system(s) fulfil(s) the requirements of paragraph 6. and, if applicable, paragraph 7. of this Regulation, type approval shall be granted.

requirements.text: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.
requirements.quote: In case of an ESA is (part of) a light source and if the documentation as specified in paragraph 3.2.10. above is missing, approval of this ESA according to Regulation No. 10 shall not be granted.

requirements.text: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle or ESA type approved in accordance with Schedule 4 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).
requirements.quote: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle or ESA type approved in accordance with Schedule 4 of the 1958 Agreement (E/ECE/TRANS/505/Rev.3).

requirements.text: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: An approval mark described in paragraph 5.3. below shall be affixed to every ESA conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.text: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.
requirements.quote: An international approval mark shall be affixed, in a conspicuous and easily accessible place specified on the approval communication form, on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation.

requirements.text: The international approval mark affixed on each vehicle conforming to the type approved under this Regulation shall comprise a circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.
requirements.quote: A circle containing the letter "E", followed by the distinguishing number of the country granting the approval.

requirements.text: The international approval mark shall comprise the number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.
requirements.quote: The number of this Regulation, followed by the letter "R", a dash and the approval number to the right of the circle specified in paragraph 5.3.1. above.

requirements.text: The vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: A vehicle and its electrical/electronic system(s) or ESA(s) shall be designed, constructed and fitted in such a way as to enable the vehicle, in normal conditions of use, to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions.
requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.text: The ESA(s) shall be tested for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.
requirements.quote: ESA(s) shall be tested for radiated and conducted emissions, for immunity to radiated and conducted disturbances.

requirements.text: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.
requirements.quote: Before testing, the Technical Service shall prepare a test plan in conjunction with the manufacturer, which contains at least mode of operation, stimulated function(s), monitored function(s), pass/fail criterion(criteria) and intended emissions.

requirements.text: Depending on the intended operating conditions of the propulsion system, the test plan shall define the minimum number of steady state operating conditions of the vehicle, selectable by the driver or by the control system.
requirements.quote: Depending on the intended operating conditions of the propulsion system, the test plan shall define the minimum number of steady state operating conditions of the vehicle, selectable by the driver or by the control system.

requirements.text: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system.
requirements.quote: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system and shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).

requirements.text: The test conditions shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).
requirements.quote: The test conditions shall consider multiple propulsion system operating strategies which can be activated permanently by the driver or the vehicle control system and shall be based on documentation provided in Annexes 2A and 2B (e.g. risk analysis).

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.
requirements.quote: Method of measurement The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limits shall be 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the limits shall be 62 to 52 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 52 to 63 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 6 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 7, the ESA broadband limit shall remain constant at 63 dB microvolts/m in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 63 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured values, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.
requirements.quote: Method of measurement The electromagnetic radiation generated by the ESA representative of its type shall be measured by the method described in Annex 8.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits for the ESA narrowband type approval shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits for the ESA narrowband type approval shall be 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.
requirements.quote: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, the limits shall be 52 to 42 dB microvolts/m in the 30 to 75 MHz frequency band, this limit decreasing logarithmically with frequencies above 30 MHz, and 42 to 53 dB microvolts/m in the 75 to 400 MHz band, this limit increasing logarithmically with frequencies above 75 MHz as shown in Appendix 7.

requirements.text: If measurements are made using the method described in Annex 8, in the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit for the ESA narrowband type approval shall remain constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.
requirements.quote: In the 400 to 1,000 MHz frequency band the limit remains constant at 53 dB microvolts/m.

requirements.text: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m, shall be below the ESA narrowband type approval limits.
requirements.quote: On the ESA representative of its type, the measured value, expressed in dB microvolts/m shall be below the type approval limits.

requirements.text: The emission of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.
requirements.quote: The emission of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 for the levels given in Table 1.

requirements.text: When tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 (Table 1), the positive pulse amplitude for vehicles with 12 V systems shall not exceed +75 V.
requirements.quote: Positive +75 V +150 V

requirements.text: When tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 (Table 1), the positive pulse amplitude for vehicles with 24 V systems shall not exceed +150 V.
requirements.quote: Positive +75 V +150 V

requirements.text: When tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 (Table 1), the negative pulse amplitude for vehicles with 12 V systems shall not exceed -100 V.
requirements.quote: Negative -100 V -450 V

requirements.text: When tested by the method(s) according to ISO 7637-2 as described in Annex 10 (Table 1), the negative pulse amplitude for vehicles with 24 V systems shall not exceed -450 V.
requirements.quote: Negative -100 V -450 V

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.
requirements.quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) chosen from those described in Annex 9.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2a.
requirements.quote: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9: Test severity in over 90 per cent of the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band are given in Table 2a.

requirements.text: The immunity to electromagnetic radiation of the ESA representative of its type shall be tested by the method(s) as described in Annex 9 with the test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.
requirements.quote: Test severity for the minimum test Level over the whole 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency band given in Table 2b.

requirements.text: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there is no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".
requirements.quote: The ESA representative of its type shall be considered as complying with immunity requirements if, during the tests performed in accordance with Annex 9, there shall be no degradation of performance of "immunity related functions".

requirements.text: The immunity of the ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.
requirements.quote: The immunity of ESA representative of this type shall be tested by the method(s) according to ISO 16750-2 for starting profile and ISO 7637-2 for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b, as described in Annex 10, with the test levels given in Tables 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: The starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.
requirements.quote: Starting profile shall be tested according to the functional status classification as defined in ISO 16750-1.

requirements.text: The Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.
requirements.quote: Functional Performance Status Classification (FPSC) as in ISO 7637-1 shall be applied for pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b.

requirements.text: During the test, the ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be in normal operation mode, preferably in maximum load.

requirements.text: During the test, ESAs involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be in charging mode.
requirements.quote: ESAs involved in "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall be in charging mode.

requirements.text: During the whole frequency range measurement, the state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC.
requirements.quote: The state of charge (SOC) of the traction battery shall be kept between 20 per cent and 80 per cent of the maximum SOC during the whole frequency range measurement (this may lead to split the measurement in different sub-bands with the need to discharge the vehicle's traction battery before starting the next sub-bands).

requirements.text: If the test is not performed with a REESS, the ESA should be tested at rated current.
requirements.quote: If the test is not performed with a REESS the ESA should be tested at rated current.

requirements.text: If the current consumption can be adjusted, for AC charging the current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of the maximum rated charging/input current value.
requirements.quote: If the current consumption can be adjusted, then the current shall be set to at least 80 per cent of its maximum rated charging/input current value for AC charging.

requirements.text: If the current consumption can be adjusted, for DC charging the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of the nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of the nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility), unless another value is agreed with the type approval authorities.
requirements.quote: If the current consumption can be adjusted, then the current shall be set to at least 20 per cent of its nominal value or to a minimum of 16 A (if the 20 per cent of its nominal value cannot be achieved in the test facility) for DC charging unless another value is agreed with the type approval authorities.

requirements.text: For measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS), the limits shall apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz.
requirements.quote: The limits apply throughout the frequency range 30 to 1,000 MHz for measurements performed in an absorber lined shielded enclosure (ALSE) or open area test site (OATS).

requirements.text: If peak detectors are used, a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.
requirements.quote: If peak detectors are used a correction factor of 20 dB as defined in CISPR 12 shall be applied.

requirements.text: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the test methods (a) absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2, (b) TEM cell testing according to ISO 11452-3, (c) bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4, (d) stripline testing according to ISO 11452-5, (e) reverberation chamber test according to ISO 11452-11, at the manufacturer's discretion, provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.quote: ESAs may comply with the requirements of any combination of the following test methods at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered:

requirements.text: ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall comply with the requirements of the combination of the Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2 and Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4 at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.
requirements.quote: ESAs in configuration "REESS charging mode coupled to the power grid" shall comply with the requirements of the combination of the Absorber chamber test according to ISO 11452-2 and Bulk current injection testing according to ISO 11452-4 at the manufacturer's discretion provided that these results in the full frequency range specified in paragraph 3.1. of this Annex being covered.

requirements.text: The frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: (Frequency range and general test conditions shall be based on ISO 11452-1).

requirements.text: During the test, the ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.
requirements.quote: The ESA under test shall be switched on and shall be stimulated to be in normal operation condition.

requirements.text: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: Measurements shall be made in the 20 to 6,000 MHz frequency range with frequency steps according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range.
requirements.quote: (a) AM (amplitude modulation), with 1 kHz modulation and 80 per cent modulation depth in the 20 to 400 MHz frequency range;

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range.
requirements.quote: (b) PM2 (pulse modulation type 2), Ton 3 µs, period 3,333 µs in the 2,700 to 3,100 MHz frequency range; and

requirements.text: The test signal modulation shall be PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.
requirements.quote: (c) PM3 (pulse modulation type 3), Ton 500 µs, period 1,000 µs in the 380 to 2,700 MHz and the 3,100 to 6,000 MHz frequency ranges.

requirements.text: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer, the frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.
requirements.quote: If not otherwise agreed between Technical Service and ESA manufacturer. Frequency step size and dwell time shall be chosen according to ISO 11452-1.

requirements.text: The test method for immunity to and emission of transients of electrical/electronic sub-assemblies (ESAs) shall ensure the immunity of the ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply.
requirements.quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.

requirements.text: The test method for immunity to and emission of transients of electrical/electronic sub-assemblies (ESAs) shall limit conducted transients from the ESAs to the vehicle power supply.
requirements.quote: This test method shall ensure the immunity of ESAs to conducted transients on the vehicle power supply and limit conducted transients from ESAs to the vehicle power supply.

requirements.text: When testing immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Apply the test pulses 1, 2a, 2b, 3a and 3b according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

requirements.text: When testing immunity against transient disturbances conducted along 12/24 V supply lines, the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 shall be applied to the supply lines as well as to other connections of the ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines, except that ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to the starting profile.
requirements.quote: Apply the starting profile according to the International Standard ISO 16750-2 to the supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines. ESAs that are exclusively reserved for mounting on electric vehicles (vehicles without 12V/24V starter motor) are not subject to starting profile.

requirements.text: When testing the emission of transient conducted disturbances generated by ESAs on 12/24 V supply lines, the measurement shall be made according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as on other connections of the ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.
requirements.quote: Measurement according to the International Standard ISO 7637-2 on supply lines as well as to other connections of ESAs which may be operationally connected to supply lines.

regulations.rationale: Consolidated device regulation covering the rear position lamp, stop lamp and reversing lamp in this module. (lexical: term match score 14.8)
Installation regulation for lighting and light-signalling devices on M1 vehicles, which is where this lamp is fitted. (lexical: term match score 34.9)
Consolidated retro-reflective device regulation covering the integrated retro-reflector. (lexical: term match score 7.7)
The lamp contains LED modules on a PCB, an electronic sub-assembly, so EMC requirements apply. (lexical: term match score 9.3)
Legacy regulation for position and stop lamps, now consolidated into R148, which is preferred. (lexical: term match score 1.6; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Legacy reversing lamp regulation, consolidated into R148, which is preferred. (lexical: term match score 1.6; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Legacy retro-reflector regulation; superseded by R150, which is preferred. (lexical: term match score 0.7; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
The LEDs are non-replaceable modules on a PCB rather than approved LED light source categories. (lexical: term match score 11.5)
External projections apply to the vehicle body; a rear lamp is not typically assessed as a separate product under this regulation. (lexical: term match score 0.2)
The lamp uses LED modules, not filament light sources. (lexical: term match score 0.5)
Covers road illumination devices (headlamps, fog lamps), not rear signalling. (lexical: term match score 9.4)
The module has no rear fog lamp. (lexical: term match score 0.8; superseded by a consolidated regulation)
Braking system regulation, not the stop lamp device. (lexical: term match score 0.7)
The module contains no direction indicator, so R6 is not relevant. (lexical: term match score 0.6; superseded by a consolidated regulation)

profile.product: Rear lamp (combined rear lighting and signalling module with rear position lamp, stop lamp, reversing lamp, outer lens and retro-reflector in a single housing)
functions: Rear position signalling (presence/visibility) - rear position lamp, 4 to 17 cd on axis
Braking indication - stop lamp, 60 to 185 cd on axis
Reversing illumination - reversing lamp, visible to 45° outboard
Passive conspicuity - retro-reflector, reflectivity at 5° angle of incidence
Light transmission and colour definition - outer lens, red within the chromaticity limits
Sealing against water ingress - no water ingress after the spray test
materials: Reflector surface: PC with aluminium vacuum-metallised coating
Light source: LED modules on PCB
Fasteners / clips: PA, POM, or steel
